prompt: Create an original 150 second instrumental dub instrumental composition for nature documentary, landscape and gentle exploration. Mood: organic, open, fresh. Instruments: round electric bass, organ, rimshot, echo guitar. Style: spacious offbeat chords with restrained tape delay. Tempo approximately 72 BPM; D dorian. Main idea: an ascending fourth answered by a stepwise descent. Introduce a gently rising motif and a sense of open air. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:50] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:50-01:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:40-02:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 02:30.

description.en: A calm and reflective instrumental track featuring a steady drum beat, melodic electric guitar, piano, and atmospheric synth pads, underpinned by a smooth bassline.
description.zh: 一首平静而富有沉思感的器乐曲，以稳定的鼓点、旋律优美的电吉他、钢琴和氛围合成器铺垫，低音线条流畅。

metadataBasis: style/scenario/tempo/key/moods are prompt intent; duration is measured; energy and audioReview are model inference when energyBasis is automated-audio-review
